setup: You are subtracting [[b]] from [[a]], and the ones digits do not work without borrowing.

steps.say: The ones digits are [[ones_a]] and [[ones_b]]. Since [[ones_b]] is larger, you cannot just take it away — a single one is not enough.
Borrow: trade one ten from the tens column ([[tens_a]] tens) for ten ones. The ones column now has [[ones_a]] + 10, which does cover [[ones_b]].
With [[ones_a]] + 10 = [[ones_after_borrow]] in the ones column, taking away [[ones_b]] leaves [[ones_diff]].
The borrowed ten has gone from the tens column, so that column is now [[tens_a]] − 1 = [[tens_left]]. Multiplying out gives the whole difference: [[a]] − [[b]] = [[diff]].

answer: Borrowing one ten from the tens column makes the ones column work, and [[a]] − [[b]] = [[diff]].
